SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS test_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.web_order_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE o.web_order_id END) AS with_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_rows_all_time
FROM o
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id AS web_order_id, product_key FROM fact_sales_line) s ON s.web_order_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = s.product_key
